PicAlive 3D

Turn real products into 3D

Walk around a product with your phone. Get a realistic 3D model you can turn all the way round, place in your room and share.

My live pictures

My 3D models

1Walk around the productPut it on a table with space around it. The app shows a ring and takes sharp photos by itself as you walk around.
2Build the 3D modelThe photos go to a 3D service that builds a detailed, textured model in a few minutes.
3Turn it, place it, share itSpin it all the way round, see it at real size on your table, and save it as a 3D file.

Add picture

For best results: shoot the picture straight on, in good light, with no glare. Pictures with lots of detail work best. Plain logos, blank walls and very shiny surfaces track poorly.
Drag the corners so the box holds only the picture.

Understanding your picture

The app finds the sky, water, trees, people and lights in your picture, and how deep everything is, then moves each part in its own way.
